integrity: An analytic proof is supplied and a finite exact-rational checker exercises its structural identities; finite tests do not certify general quantifiers. Scientific publication priority is not independently established.
scientific_limitations: Consistent real planar equations with a>=1 labelled identical unit rows, one rare distinct unit row, independent uniform full reshuffles, 0<absolute normal overlap<1, exact unrelaxed orthogonal projections, and a nonzero starting error orthogonal to the repeated row. Rates are per epoch; no arbitrary multilevel row geometry or runtime-optimality assertion.
title: Exact annealed and quenched rates for one-rare-row reshuffled Kaczmarz
